import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):

    sum_tile = nl.ndarray((C, H // p, p, W // p, p), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=sum_tile, src=t)
    
    # Compute sum over the last two dimensions (p, p)
    sum_result = nl.sum(sum_tile, axis=[3, 4], keepdims=True)
